name: sc2-adjutant
description: Co-design StarCraft II campaign Missions with sc2-adjutant: its MCP server for the Workspace you have open, the level-design, hero-mission-design, encounter-design, ally-design, exemplar-design, style-pack-builder, texture-sets, doodad-search, custom-doodads, cinematography, boss-design, boss-build and sound-mix skills, the melee-design skill for 1v1 melee maps, the report-missing-feature skill for reporting what sc2-adjutant can't do yet, and commands for the co-design session.
